notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (Nutrition is a governmental special revenue fund in the Other Governmental Funds column; no proprietary statement). Balance sheet uses the governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances (p4, Total Governmental Funds, fund balance by classification); its totals 18,245,419 equal the government-wide statement (p2). Roll-forward: 14,351,490 + 14,804,050 - 10,910,121 + 200,000 - 200,000 = 18,245,419. 'Other local receipts' 2,860,899 split using the fund schedules (Special Building contributions 2,750,000; General Fund 1800/1910/1911/1925 lines = 110,899). 'State receipts' 5,511,627 split using the General Fund schedule (p6): Homestead Exemption 16,089, Property Tax Credit 731,166, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 4,551, remainder 4,759,821 state aid (incl. Nutrition state reimbursement 1,209). 'Non-revenue receipts' 3,697 (General 120 + Depreciation 2,750 + Nutrition 827) unexplained, kept as other with review. Transfers: General Fund transfers out 200,000 = Activities 70,000 + Nutrition 130,000 (both match). The Depreciation Fund transfer of 500,000 to the General component is inside the combined General Fund column (eliminated on p3). Hidden reclassification: the combining schedule (p5, which is cut off after General administration) shows a 970,957 reclassification into Instruction; the General Fund budget schedule lines 3300-6988 (sum 970,957) are counted under Instruction by the statement; in detail 3541/3551 (printed under the '3500 State categorical programs' heading) are State Categorical Programs, 2310-2330 are General Administration, the federal program lines (no federal programs heading printed) stay instruction. The p5 General Fund combining schedule is truncated and duplicates the budget schedules, so it is not recorded in detail (no double counting). General Fund 'General' schedule excludes Depreciation and Employee Benefit, which are recorded from their own schedules. Budget-only lines with blank actual (4525, 4709, Reappropriated funds, Activities/Special building blank interest) are omitted. Activities Fund spending (2900 Support Services, Other, 106,294) is printed in the statement under Student support services; that line is split by column into General Fund 567,080 (support services) + Other Governmental 106,294 (student activities). Detail totals for General and other funds include the printed transfers (marked includes other financing). Attempt 2: audit fixes applied (balance sheet basis, state receipts split, 2300 and 3500 categories). Read pages 1-14 of 14
